au-uq-appendicular-osteosarcoma-vaccine.identity: Exact University of Queensland two-formulation experimental vaccine for recently diagnosed appendicular osteosarcoma, linked current UQ VETS entry and matching original trial details.
au-uq-appendicular-osteosarcoma-vaccine.recruitment_sites: Current UQ VETS active named listing and PetTrials exact item; UQ Gatton original site/Brisbane-area preference retained with confirmation before travel.
au-uq-appendicular-osteosarcoma-vaccine.eligibility: Dog of any breed with recent limb-long-bone OSA, no evidence of metastasis on exam/radiographs and surgery planned; tumor and blood collected at surgery; current page does not alter original local logistics.
au-uq-appendicular-osteosarcoma-vaccine.funding: Two vaccine doses are free; surgery and remaining owner charges not expressly covered.
au-uq-appendicular-osteosarcoma-vaccine.contacts: UQ clinical research trial webform; original exact protocol lists Dr José Granados Soler and Rachel Allavena.
au-uq-appendicular-osteosarcoma-vaccine.deadline: No published calendar cutoff; first dose within two weeks of surgery, then booster three weeks later.
